title: Orphan Games: Atari 2600 in the FPGA
summary: The Atari 2600 rebuilt in the FPGA (A2601 by Retromaster, from the MiSTer Atari 2600 core, GPL-3): its 6507 CPU, TIA picture and sound chip and RIOT in hardware. Play 2600 carts from the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Carts up to 32 KB with the usual bank switching (2K, 4K, F8, F6, F4, FA, FE, E0, E7, 3F, UA, F0, Pitfall II's DPC) and Superchip RAM, chosen automatically. Real NES controllers plug into the hashboard connectors (J1 and J2, or any J with ORPHAN_NES_PADS) through the same small 3.3 V adapter as the NES: pad 1 is joystick 1, pad 2 joystick 2 (not tested with a NES controller, yet). Disconnect every hashboard first. No paddles or keypads yet. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: Atari 2600 (cart, frame buffer, sound, joysticks, real NES pads on J1..J9)
